messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++11 code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

samples.content:
<perturbed_code_1>
#include <iostream>
#define MOD 1ll * 1000000007
using namespace std;

int put(int nr, int p);

int main()
{
	long long p, k, q;
	cin >> p >> k;
	q = k;
	if (k == 0) {
		cout << put(p, p - 1);
			return 0;
	}
	if (k == 1) {
		cout << put(p, p);
		return 0;
	}
	int n = 1;
	while (q != 1) {
		q *= k;
		q %= p;
		n++;
	}
	cout << put(p, (p - 1) / n);
	return 0;
}

int put(int nr, int p)
{
	if (p == 0)
		return 1;
	long long a = put(nr, p / 2);
	a *= a;
	a %= MOD;
	if (p & 1) {
		a *= nr;
		a %= MOD;
	}
	return a;
}
